import sys


def main():
    jobs = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) != 4:
            continue
        try:
            name, arrival, duration, priority = parts
            arrival = int(arrival)
            duration = int(duration)
            priority = int(priority)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        jobs.append((name, arrival, duration, priority))

    # Sort by priority descending, arrival ascending, name ascending
    jobs.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[3], x[1], x[0]))

    time = 0
    idle = 0
    while jobs or time < float("inf"):
        # Find the next eligible job
        eligible = [job for job in jobs if job[1] <= time]
        if not eligible:
            # No jobs arrived yet; idle
            next_arrival = min(job[1] for job in jobs) if jobs else float("inf")
            idle += next_arrival - time
            time = next_arrival
            continue

        # Select the best job from eligible ones
        selected = max(eligible, key=lambda j: ( -j[3], j[1], j[0] ))
        # Run the job
        start = time
        end = start + selected[2]
        print(f"{selected[0]} {start} {end}")
        time = end

        # Remove the job from the list
        jobs.remove(selected)

    print(f"idle {idle}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
